entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-16
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Correlated FirstOrDefault subquery over a Concat/Union (keyless) source inside a collection projection: silently missing collection elements (single query) or ArgumentOutOfRangeException (split query) #38660
  • Required owned entity on a TPH derived type is materialized for an unrelated row #38659

Closed

  • Handle the new Min/Max Span overloads #38508
    10.0.11
  • Remove-Migration is corrupting the DbContextModelSnapshot #36180
    11.0.0
  • EF does not honor ProjectDepsFileName property in startup-project #38173
    11.0.0
  • PendingModelChangesWarning Diacritic Café #38191
    11.0.0
  • SQLite vulnerbilities #38257
    10.0.11

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/10.0]: Bump SQLite3MC.PCLRaw.bundle from 2.3.5 to 2.3.6 #38663
    area-infrastructure
  • Cosmos: Modernize serialization in query pipeline #38662
    community-contribution

Merged

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #38604
  • Enable unsafe PR checkout in API review workflow #38657
  • Fix test helper method override assertions for arbitrary parameters #38633
    community-contribution
  • Fix shared type entity type name generation in model snapshot #38611
  • [release/10.0] Handle MemoryExtensions.Min/Max Span overloads introduced in .NET 11 #38618
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.11
  • Honor startup `ProjectDepsFileName` / `ProjectRuntimeConfigFileName` in dotnet-ef host launch #38595
  • Normalize Unicode strings from seed data before comparing #38617
  • Fix flaky parallel split query test: move ClearLog() before parallel tasks #38640
  • [release/10.0]: Bump Microsoft.Data.SqlClient from 6.1.1 to 6.1.6 #38650
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/10.0] Update SQLitePCLRaw package versions #38607
    Servicing-approved, 10.0.11
  • [release/9.0] Update SQLitePCLRaw package versions #38606
    Servicing-approved, 9.0.19

Updated

  • Bump Microsoft.DotNet.XUnitV3Extensions from 11.0.0-beta.26329.101 to 11.0.0-beta.26365.108 #38647
    area-infrastructure
  • Handle out-of-order split-include rows to prevent child collection loss under concurrent inserts #38590
  • Warn and fix identity conflict when owned entity has inconsistent data in DB #38596
  • Cosmos: run query response status checks inside execution strategy retries #38591
  • [release/9.0]: Bump OpenTelemetry.Exporter.InMemory from 1.8.1 to 1.16.0 #38656
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/10.0]: Bump OpenTelemetry.Exporter.InMemory from 1.12.0 to 1.16.0 #38655
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/10.0]: Bump Newtonsoft.Json from 13.0.3 to 13.0.4 #38652
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/9.0]: Bump Newtonsoft.Json from 13.0.3 to 13.0.4 #38654
    area-infrastructure
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0' => 'release/10.0' #38627
